meta.name: Realm Elites
meta.notes: Mid-tier overworld creatures (16-22px), two per biome, between the 8px enemies and the 32px bosses. Each has walk, attack, a signature ability, hurt and a dissolve death; 'info' gives the ability and its two shots. Shots point right. Sheets prefixed el_.

reef_golem.title: Reef Golem
reef_golem.ability_text: Coral surges over its body into a glowing shell. Invulnerable while the shell holds.

siren.title: Siren
siren.ability_text: She sings; notes spiral out and a charm ring pulses. Players caught in it are slowed.

goblin_shaman.title: Goblin Shaman
goblin_shaman.ability_text: Plants a carved totem that rises out of the ground and pulses healing to nearby goblins.

bramble_bear.title: Bramble Bear
bramble_bear.ability_text: Rears onto its hind legs and roars; the brambles on its back fire thorns in every direction.

orc_warlord.title: Orc Warlord
orc_warlord.ability_text: Plants a war banner and roars; a red aura makes nearby orcs faster and harder to kill.

spider_queen.title: Spider Queen
spider_queen.ability_text: Her egg sac swells and splits; spiderlings scatter out and swarm.

storm_gryphon.title: Storm Gryphon
storm_gryphon.ability_text: Folds its wings, wraps itself in lightning and dives at a player, leaving after-images.

rock_troll.title: Rock Troll
rock_troll.ability_text: Sinks into the ground, moves as a rubble mound, then bursts out beneath a player.

void_seer.title: Void Seer
void_seer.ability_text: Unravels into motes, vanishes, and re-forms somewhere else nearby.

abyss_hound.title: Abyss Hound
abyss_hound.ability_text: Crouches, then lunges in a blur, leaving shadow copies behind it.

reef_golem.brine_bubble.text: Slow bubble that bursts into foam.

siren.song_note.text: Notes that curve toward the player.

siren.tide_orb.text: Water orb that leaves a ripple where it lands.

goblin_shaman.spirit_flame.text: Slow green flame that homes in.

bramble_bear.pollen_puff.text: Drifting cloud that blinds on hit.

spider_queen.venom_spit.text: Poison glob fired in an arc.

storm_gryphon.lightning_feather.text: Fast feather wrapped in a spark.

storm_gryphon.static_orb.text: Slow orb that crackles and shocks nearby.

void_seer.void_bolt.text: A thrown eye that tracks briefly.

void_seer.rift_star.text: Spinning star that splits in two.

abyss_hound.shadow_fang.text: A bite of shadow, fast and short range.

abyss_hound.rift_flame.text: Magenta flame that burns over time.
